theorems.name: Submission.dohr_tp_ae_lebesgue_point_of_growth
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (f : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Integrable f ν → (∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ν (closedBall z r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)) → ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((r ^ n)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ w in closedBall y r, ‖f w - f y‖ₑ ∂ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
